body.name: Algebra-collision gray zone
body.construction: For a predeclared frame of dimension \(d<K\), set \(\rho_N=c_{\rho}\sqrt{\log N/N}\) and \(s_{d+1}(m)=\sigma_{d+1}(V_D(m))\). Define \(\mathcal Z_{\mathrm{gray},N}=\{m:0<s_{d+1}(m)\le\rho_N\}\cup\{m:\rho_N<s_{d+1}(m)<\kappa_{\mathrm{gap}}\}\). The first component is the sampling-noise collision band and the second is the weakly separated band; exact rank-\(d\) laws with \(s_{d+1}(m)=0\) and laws with \(s_{d+1}(m)\ge\kappa_{\mathrm{gap}}\) are outside this population gray zone. For \(d=K\), set \(\mathcal Z_{\mathrm{gray},N}=\varnothing\).
